verdict.rationale: vLLM ships an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API server (vllm-docs-9, vllm-docs-15) that inherently listens on a network port and can be reached from other devices, and community evidence confirms real-world use of this API (vllm-comm-2). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents host/port binding, firewall, or LAN-access configuration for multi-device use. Missing for 10: explicit docs on binding to 0.0.0.0/network interfaces, guidance on exposing the server to other devices, and hands-on confirmation of local-network access working as expected.
